current_host_comparison.finding: Attachment and slider presenters already copy sourceWindow.overrideUserInterfaceStyle. PreviewAppearance.applyToWindows updates all active scene windows. A missing global light/dark forwarding claim is unsupported.

Both independent UIHostingController roots are reconstructed outside the originating SwiftUI tree and do not explicitly receive source MessageInputStyle/rail color/theme presentation inputs. Current slider rail fixed OneOff/AppForeground ignores source-proved parameter precedence. Capture explicit effective inputs at caller; do not attempt to transplant an unknown complete environment.

Permission and advanced config are ordinary SwiftUI.sheet descendants, unlike independent overlay windows. Existing semantic resource colors and native sheets should be retained; no blanket UIKit-window wrapper is needed.
Current attachment material resolver already distinguishes nil/present backgroundMaterial and colorScheme. Do not force present merely because UIKit surface uses UIGlassEffect.
Current ApprovalCard appearance is injected on taskBottomBars only, consistent with source-scoped maxWidth. Do not generalize to permission/model sheets.

safe_product_decision.implementable: Introduce explicit slider appearance inputs representing modelSlider.railColor override, optional VM tint, and effective primaryButton.primaryColor fallback. Supply ordinary theme-resolved primary color from its parent with the exact source precedence. Reuse current semantic palette/current theme owner rather than fixed AppForeground. Pass the same computed input to the new hosting root; retain dynamic UIColor/SwiftUI Color trait behavior.
safe_product_decision.preserve: Existing UIWindow interfaceStyle forwarding, active-window appearance refresh, slider untinted regular glass and semantic fallback; native permission/advanced sheet presentation and scoped ApprovalCard maxWidth.
safe_product_decision.not_source_recovered: Any complete SwiftUI environment snapshot, new blanket theme wrapper, explicit nonnil attachment backgroundMaterial, global card-width injection, or guessed screenshot-derived green/blue. These are not justified.
